entries.text: Aaand made it to station number three![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.text: How we doing after all that walking and battling\nand whatnot? Anyone need a rest?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.text: Hm? Oh, no, it’s not that.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1100_botan_02

entries.text: I’ve just been thinking ever since the professor\nmentioned that time machine...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1100_botan_03

entries.text:
The Pokémon here in Area Zero came to our
time from the past, right?\c
So what about Koraidon? Isn’t it pretty likely
that it’s also one of those ancient Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.text:
The Pokémon here in Area Zero came to our
time from the future, right?\c
So what about Miraidon? Isn’t it pretty likely
that it’s also one of those future Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.text: I think you’re onto something! It is kinda giving\noff ancient vibes. Even its name sounds...past-y![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.text: Wait a sec—I totally forgot! Hey, Arven![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1100_rival_06

entries.text: You had [VAR 0x0101(0001)]’s ball! And you told us about\nits forms in the first place!\c\nYou must know something about it, right?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1100_rival_07

entries.text:
Urk. You still remember that from way back?
No wonder you’re everybody’s little star pupil.\c
Guess I’ve got no choice, then, but to tell you
what I know...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1100_friend_01

entries.text: It was found by my mom when she was working\non her time machine.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: Well, that makes sense, I guess... They do\nlook alike.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.text: Huh? You mean...there’s another one around\nhere somewhere?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: What if they’re family?! The other one could still\nbe somewhere in Area Zero, waiting to finally\r\nbe reunited with our [VAR 0x0101(0001)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1100_rival_15

entries.text: Exactly! Imagine how thrilled they’ll be if we can\nget the family back together after all this time![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1100_rival_16

entries.text: Family, huh... Yeah... That sounds nice.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: If we could proceed, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?\c\nPlease disable the next lock using the central\npanel there.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.text: If that other Pokémon really is the only family\nit has left in the world...\c\nIt must want to be together again, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: These plot twists really tug at the heartstrings,\ndon’t they? Not that I’m complaining.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.text: If you’re not gonna bother with the lock, mind\nif I take apart that panel to see what’s inside?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.text: Um, isn’t that one of those research stations?\nI thought we were supposed to disable the locks.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
